name: Potent Conduit
body:
You can convert excess positive or negative energy into physical power.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast cure or inflict spells.

Benefit(s): Whenever you cast a cure spell, until the end of your next turn you gain a morale bonus on your next attack roll equal to the spell cast.

Whenever you cast an inflict spell, until the end of your next turn you deal extra damage on your next weapon damage roll equal to twice the level of the spell.
